# Exact period-two interior coefficients

The tables give the positive-offset taps of `hD`. The central tap is zero
and the negative-offset taps are the negatives of the corresponding positive
taps. The norm is `h*diag(w)`. Phase A is the even zero-based index.
Regenerate these values and all closure coefficients with
`experiments/certify_alternating.jl` and `Experimental.search_stencil`.
